System: LAC Improved Counterweight Kit – GPNVG

Model: LAC-ICWK

Configuration: Multicam

Description:

The Licentia Arms Improved Counterweight Kit is a purpose built counterweight system that functions as a night vision counterweight and a secure GPNVG battery pack holder. Constructed from laser cut laminate Cordura the LAC Improved Counterweight Kit is low profile, has positive retention, offers cable management, and has loop velcro for patches.

Adding a counterweight to the back of a night vision helmet helps balance out weight distribution and improves comfort for the user. Historically there has been no great solution for securing a GPNVG battery pack to a helmet without makeshift modifications. Licentia Arms Co. solved this problem. Users who use a GPNVG battery pack can now secure them to their helmet without fear of loosing an expensive battery pack. This not only secures the battery pack, but also protects it while providing cable management solutions. By securing the battery pack cable the user eliminates the need to rig up sub par ways to eliminate snag hazards.

The LAC Improved Counterweight Kit is physically retained on the helmet by both hook velcro and anchors that attach to the rear rail bolts on any helmet. By using high strength shot cord for retention the counterweight kit is universal to all helmets and has two forms of retention. Surrounding the main counterweight compartment there are four elastic loops (two on top & two on the bottom) to secure chemlights and cables.

Includes:

• Counterweight pouch

• Retention tabs & shot cord
